Product / owner experience

Bring the mission.
Not the machinery.

Restless is intended to feel like appointing a capable company, not configuring an agent framework. The owner remains the source of direction, limits and judgement.

What changes

Your working day has fewer open loops.

You ask for an outcome once. A singleton Exec places it with one accountable lead. Staff does the machine-doable work. The lead stays available to notice drift, redirect production and judge the exact result.

The return is not a cheerful summary. It is the native artifact, supporting evidence, and a bounded decision if one remains.

The prepared last mile

Restless stops at the line only you can cross.

Identity, sign-in, CAPTCHA, two-factor authentication, legal attestation, payment confirmation and irreducible taste stay with you. The surrounding workflow does not.

Prepared owner action

Approve the final production order

Already done
Supplier terms compared, quantities checked, draft order preserved
Your act
Legal acceptance and payment confirmation
Resume signal
Provider order state observed

Product boundary

The target is a company control plane.

It is for

Useful economic output per unit of owner attention, time, cost and bounded risk.

It is not primarily

A chat assistant, agent builder, workflow canvas, task tracker or audit product.

Current maturity

A clean-slate research programme with explicit architecture and controlled dogfood, not claimed general availability.
